name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
summary: Atal Pension Yojana is a government-backed periodic pension scheme targeted primarily at the unorganized sector workers to provide social security and financial independence in old age.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen between 18 and 40 years of age having a savings bank account or post office account. Individuals who are income taxpayers are not eligible to join APY (rule effective from October 1, 2022).
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month starting at age 60, depending on the subscriber's contribution and age at entry. Upon subscriber death, the same pension continues to spouse; after spouse's demise, total accumulated pension corpus is returned to the nominee.
application_process: Apply through any nationalized or private bank branch where the savings account is maintained, or via net banking. Auto-debit facility from bank account is required.
key_facts: Entry age window: 18 to 40 years; minimum contribution tenure is 20 years.
Central government co-contribution and tax benefits under section 80CCD.
Administered by PFRDA through the National Pension System (NPS) architecture.
